## History

Hammond worked at a small sawmill and was married to Mrs. Hammond, with whom he had eight children. His life was defined by his work at the mill and raising his large family alongside his wife.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)_
